video.comment_duration: Shortened from 30s to ~24s target. Shorts distribution leans on average-view-DURATION-as-a-percentage and on loops; a 24s video that gets watched twice beats a 30s video abandoned at 60%.
video.comment_cuts: clip_cut_seconds lowered 2.5 -> 1.8 so the visual changes ~13 times instead of ~12 in a shorter runtime. Faster cuts measurably reduce mid-video swipe-away.
video.comment_voice: Sweet USA girl voice tells a heartwarming story. Short on-screen hook for the first 2.5s, then captions run for the rest.

transitions.comment: Short crossfade between background segments for a premium feel.

palette.comment: Warm soft golden / peach / cream tones for a cozy heartwarming look

captions.comment: TURNED BACK ON. A large share of Shorts plays start muted, and with captions off those viewers received no text at all - nothing to read, nothing to hold them. On-screen captions are also what makes people watch to the end of a narrated Short.

hook.comment: TURNED BACK ON, but now driven by gemini_script.SCREEN_HOOKS (2-4 word labels) instead of the long spoken sentence. Duration cut 4s -> 2.5s: the scroll decision happens inside the first ~2 seconds, and a 4s text card on a 24s video wasted a sixth of the runtime.

tts.comment: voice_pool rotates the narrator. One fixed voice across 100+ videos is an obvious mass-production signal and it also makes the library feel like one long identical video to a returning viewer.

seo.comment: Consumed by modules/seo.py. hashtag_count stays under 15 because YouTube ignores ALL hashtags on a video that carries more than 15.

thumbnail.comment: Shorts thumbnails are not used inside the Shorts player, but they ARE the channel grid, the subscriptions feed and search - the exact surfaces where a viewer decides to subscribe.

pexels.comment: Widened from 10 to 18 phrases and dropped the breed-specific 'golden retriever' query, which was pulling the same handful of stock clips into video after video.

music.comment: Voice ON. Music soft background (0.18) so sweet girl voice is clearly heard over it.

grade.comment: BRIGHT, VIVID, PUNCHY cinematic look. Vignette + warm tint OFF (no oval).

youtube.default_tags_note: FALLBACK ONLY. modules/seo.py now builds a per-video, subject-aware tag set at generate time. These are used only if that produced nothing.
youtube.hashtags_note: FALLBACK ONLY. Per-video rotating hashtags come from modules/seo.py. This single fixed string used to be appended to all 113 uploads.

instagram.comment: OFF by default - automated IG posting carries account ban risk.

posting_times_et.comment: USA Eastern Time targets; cron in workflow is UTC. EST=UTC-5, EDT=UTC-4.
